{{Quote|The war in the Core Worlds is over. We're pulling out.|Sergeant Karloss|<ref name="Fall of Corellia">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|The Fall of Corellia|Vaiken Spacedock}}</ref>}}
'''Karloss''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] in the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] who was deployed at the [[Battle of Corellia]]. He, along with most Imperial forces, was withdrawn from [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] after the Imperial defeat and was temporarily stationed at [[Vaiken Spacedock]] while awaiting redeployment. Karloss was aboard the station shortly after the [[Korriban Incursion]], when he angered the [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] he was drinking with in the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]], causing the [[Alien/Legends|alien]] to storm off.
